meta.scope: Yemen Batch 2 — Collapsed oil production, humanitarian/food insecurity, and dual exchange-rate densification under severe conflict constraints.

candidates.title: Oil production and export statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from Ministry of Oil and IMF-aligned sources
candidates.description: Statistics on crude oil production and exports. Production has collapsed from pre-war peaks near 400+ thousand barrels per day to the low tens of thousands (or lower) in recent years; export interruption has been a central fiscal and external shock.
candidates.notes: Core (collapsed) extractive node. Highest pre-war centrality; now a defining absence.

candidates.title: Humanitarian needs and food insecurity statistics
candidates.publisher: Derived from OCHA / joint monitoring and IPC-aligned sources
candidates.description: Statistics on food insecurity and humanitarian needs. Inadequate food consumption affects a majority of the population in recent monitoring; severe deprivation and reliance on crisis coping strategies are widespread across both control areas.
candidates.notes: Highest-centrality social and humanitarian node under current conditions.

candidates.title: Dual exchange-rate and rial statistics
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of Yemen / market monitoring
candidates.description: Statistics and framing of the dual exchange-rate regime. Government-controlled and Ansar Allah-controlled areas maintain sharply divergent rial rates; the divergence is a structural feature of the fragmented monetary system and a key driver of inflation differentials.
candidates.notes: Critical price and institutional-fragmentation node. Dual rates are a defining structural feature.

candidates.title: Yemen oil–humanitarian–exchange densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from oil, humanitarian and monetary sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding collapsed oil production, humanitarian/food insecurity statistics, and dual exchange-rate statistics into a coherent extractive–humanitarian–monetary layer under severe conflict constraints.
